records.jp: あたしたちがぐーすか寝てる間に、そんなことが……
records.en_original: That all happened when I was in sleep town...?
records.en_auxiliary: That all happened when I was in sleep town...?
records.en: All that happened while we were fast asleep...

records.jp: これで、一歩前進だね
records.en_original: But this is a step in the right direction.
records.en_auxiliary: But this is a step in the right direction.
records.en: That puts us one step forward.

records.jp: 伶那さんのココロトープかぁ……。<CR>どんな思い出が見られるんだろ
records.en_original: Rena's Heartscape... I wonder what kind of memories we'll see.
records.en_auxiliary: Rena's Heartscape... I wonder what kind of memories we'll see.
records.en: Rena-san's Heartscape...<CR>I wonder what kind of memories we'll see.

records.jp: 伶那さん？　どうしたの、そんな浮かない顔して
records.en_original: Rena? Why the long face?
records.en_auxiliary: Rena? Why the long face?
records.en: Rena-san? What's wrong? You look troubled.

records.jp: え、あ、いや……別に
records.en_original: Um. Er... I-it's nothing.
records.en_auxiliary: Um. Er... I-it's nothing.
records.en: Huh? Ah, no... It's nothing.

records.jp: 記憶を取り戻せるのに、<CR>なんだか嬉しくなさそうなのです
records.en_original: I thought you'd be happy to get your memories back.
records.en_auxiliary: I thought you'd be happy to get your memories back.
records.en: You can recover your memories,<CR>but you don't look very happy about it.

records.jp: それは……
records.en_original: Well...
records.en_auxiliary: Well...
records.en: Well...

records.jp: ……みんな、普通にしてるけどさ。<CR>記憶を取り戻すって、怖くない？
records.en_original: You may all be used to it, but isn't it scary? Regaining your memories.
records.en_auxiliary: You may all be used to it, but isn't it scary? Regaining your memories.
records.en: ...Everyone is acting normally, but...<CR>Aren't you afraid of getting your memories back?

records.jp: 怖い、ですか……？
records.en_original: Scary...?
records.en_auxiliary: Scary...?
records.en: Afraid...?

records.jp: 外の世界は灰でおかしくなっちゃったんでしょ？<CR>それで、私たちだけはどうにか助かってるけど……
records.en_original: The outside world is in chaos because of the Ash, isn't it? We may have been saved, but...
records.en_auxiliary: The outside world is in chaos because of the Ash, isn't it? We may have been saved, but...
records.en: The outside world was thrown into chaos by the Ash, right?<CR>And somehow only we survived, but...

records.jp: 両親や、友達は……どうなったの？
records.en_original: What about our families? Our friends?
records.en_auxiliary: What about our families? Our friends?
records.en: What happened to our parents...and our friends?

records.jp: 他にも、大切な人がいたら？<CR>靭さんや春日さん、白井さんにもいたでしょ？
records.en_original: What if we have other people important to us? Utsubo, Kasuga, and Shirai all had people like that.
records.en_auxiliary: What if we have other people important to us? Utsubo, Kasuga, and Shirai all had people like that.
records.en: What if there were other people important to us?<CR>Utsubo-san, Kasuga-san, and Shirai-san all had someone, right?

records.jp: それは……
records.en: Well...

records.jp: 全員生きてる
records.en_original: They're alive.
records.en_auxiliary: They're alive.
records.en: They're alive.

records.jp: 星崎さん……？
records.en_original: Hoshizaki...?
records.en_auxiliary: Hoshizaki...?
records.en: Hoshizaki-san...?

records.jp: シェルターみたいなとこで、<CR>あたしたちと同じように生きてる
records.en_original: Everyone is safe hiding in shelters. Just like us.
records.en_auxiliary: Everyone is safe hiding in shelters. Just like us.
records.en: They're alive somewhere like a shelter,<CR>just like we are.

records.jp: そう信じることしか、できなくない？
records.en_original: Do we have any other choice than to believe that?
records.en_auxiliary: Do we have any other choice than to believe that?
records.en: All we can do is believe that, right?

records.jp: 記憶を取り戻して元の世界のことを知らないと、<CR>生きてるのか死んでるのか、調べることもできない
records.en_original: There's no way to know if they're dead or alive until we get our memories back and learn about what's happening to our world.
records.en_auxiliary: There's no way to know if they're dead or alive until we get our memories back and learn about what's happening to our world.
records.en: Until we recover our memories and learn about the outside world,<CR>we can't even look into whether they're alive or dead.

records.jp: 一生そのモヤモヤを抱えたまま過ごすより、<CR>本当のことを知ったほうがいいって、私は思うけどな
records.en_original: Rather than sitting here moping, we should find the truth. That's what I think.
records.en_auxiliary: Rather than sitting here moping, we should find the truth. That's what I think.
records.en: I think it's better to know the truth<CR>than spend your whole life with that uncertainty hanging over you.

records.jp: まあ私は、みんなと覚えてることが全然違うから、<CR>あんまり説得力ないかもしれないけど……
records.en_original: Though I guess that's easy for me to say when I don't remember the stuff you all do.
records.en_auxiliary: Though I guess that's easy for me to say when I don't remember the stuff you all do.
records.en: Though since what I remember is completely different from everyone else,<CR>I may not be very convincing...

records.jp: 本当のこと……
records.en_original: The truth...
records.en_auxiliary: The truth...
records.en: The truth...

records.jp: ……だんだん分かってきた気がする。<CR>星崎さんのこと
records.en_original: I think I'm beginning to understand you, Hoshizaki.
records.en_auxiliary: I think I'm beginning to understand you, Hoshizaki.
records.en: ...I feel like I'm starting to understand you,<CR>Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: ええ？
records.en_original: What?
records.en_auxiliary: What?
records.en: What?

records.jp: 行動力あるよね、愛央ちゃん
records.en_original: You're a real woman of action.
records.en_auxiliary: You're a real woman of action.
records.en: You really take action, Ao-chan.

records.jp: そ、そうかな？
records.en_original: Y-you think so?
records.en_auxiliary: Y-you think so?
records.en: Y-you think so?

records.jp: うん、決断も早いし
records.en_original: Yeah. And you're decisive.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. And you're decisive.
records.en: Yeah. And you're decisive.

records.jp: リーダー向きの性格ですよね。<CR>似たような人を知っています
records.en_original: I think you have the qualities of a real leader. You actually remind me of someone.
records.en_auxiliary: I think you have the qualities of a real leader. You actually remind me of someone.
records.en: You have the right personality to be a leader.<CR>You remind me of someone I know.

records.jp: そ、そんなことないよ。<CR>なんにも考えてないだけだって！
records.en_original: Me? No way! I'm barely thinking half the time!
records.en_auxiliary: Me? No way! I'm barely thinking half the time!
records.en: Th-that's not true.<CR>I just don't think things through!

records.jp: ううん。愛央ちゃんは、<CR>いつもみんなのことを気にかけてくれているのです
records.en_original: That's not true. You're always watching out for everyone.
records.en_auxiliary: That's not true. You're always watching out for everyone.
records.en: No. Ao-chan,<CR>you are always looking out for everyone.

records.jp: 空いてる時間とか、よく話しかけに来てくれるしね
records.en_original: Yeah. You always make sure to check up on people when you have a chance.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. You always make sure to check up on people when you have a chance.
records.en: You often come talk to us when you have free time too.

records.jp: （そっか、昨日の夜も――）
records.en_original: (That's true. Even last night, she—)
records.en_auxiliary: (That's true. Even last night, she—)
records.en: (I see. Even last night—)

records.jp: なら、愛央をあたしたちのリーダーにしようよ！
records.en_original: In that case, let's make Ao our leader!
records.en_auxiliary: In that case, let's make Ao our leader!
records.en: In that case, let's make Ao our leader!

records.jp: り、り、リーダー！？<CR>無理だよ、柄じゃないって……
records.en_original: L-leader?! No way, I don't—
records.en_auxiliary: L-leader?! No way, I don't—
records.en: L-l-leader?!<CR>No way! That's not me...

records.jp: 私も、それがいいと思う
records.en_original: I concur.
records.en_auxiliary: I concur.
records.en: I think that'd be good too.

records.jp: 伶那さん……
records.en_original: Rena...
records.en_auxiliary: Rena...
records.en: Rena-san...

records.jp: うん、賛成です
records.en_original: I agree, as well.
records.en_auxiliary: I agree, as well.
records.en: Yeah, I agree.

records.jp: 私も！
records.en_original: Me too!
records.en_auxiliary: Me too!
records.en: Me too!

records.jp: みんな……
records.en_original: You guys...
records.en_auxiliary: You guys...
records.en: You guys...

records.jp: ユズちゃんはどう？
records.en_original: Yuzu, what do you think?
records.en_auxiliary: Yuzu, what do you think?
records.en: Yuzu-chan, what do you think?

records.jp: みんながそう決めたのであれば、<CR>私に反対する理由はない
records.en_original: If that's what everyone's decided, I have no reason to object.
records.en_auxiliary: If that's what everyone's decided, I have no reason to object.
records.en: If that is what everyone has decided,<CR>I have no reason to object.

records.jp: リーダー……
records.en_original: Leader...
records.en_auxiliary: Leader...
records.en: Leader...

records.jp: 私が、リーダー……
records.en_original: I'm the leader...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm the leader...
records.en: I'm the leader...

records.jp: （みんなが認めてくれている……）
records.en_original: (They all approve of me...)
records.en_auxiliary: (They all approve of me...)
records.en: (They all believe in me...)

records.jp: （こんな私でも、誰かの役に立てるのなら……）
records.en_original: (If even someone like me can be helpful to others...)
records.en_auxiliary: (If even someone like me can be helpful to others...)
records.en: (If even I can be of help to someone...)

records.jp: ……分かった。私、リーダーやってみる！
records.en_original: Okay. I'll do it!
records.en_auxiliary: Okay. I'll do it!
records.en: ...All right. I'll try being the leader!

records.jp: おおー！
records.en_original: Yayyy!
records.en_auxiliary: Yayyy!
records.en: Woo!

records.jp: 私も、覚悟決めないとね。<CR>“リーダー”に言われちゃったし
records.en_original: I'll go ahead and prepare myself for the Heartscape, Leader.
records.en_auxiliary: I'll go ahead and prepare myself for the Heartscape, Leader.
records.en: I guess I need to steel myself too.<CR>The "leader" told me to, after all.

records.jp: ちょ、やめて！<CR>普通に呼んで、ハズいから！
records.en_original: Hey, cut it out! It's embarrassing when you call me that!
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, cut it out! It's embarrassing when you call me that!
records.en: H-hey, stop!<CR>Just call me normally. It's embarrassing!

records.jp: ……とにかく！　方針は決まったね
records.en_original: Anyways! Now we have our plan.
records.en_auxiliary: Anyways! Now we have our plan.
records.en: ...Anyway! Now we know what we're doing.

records.jp: 今度はどんな景色が広がってるんだろう
records.en_original: I wonder what it'll be like...?
records.en_auxiliary: I wonder what it'll be like...?
records.en: I wonder what kind of scenery we'll find this time.

records.jp: 新しい食材も採れるかもしれないね
records.en_original: Maybe we'll find some new kinds of ingredients there.
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe we'll find some new kinds of ingredients there.
records.en: Maybe we'll find some new kinds of ingredients there.

records.jp: ……なんか、健康に良いものしか採れなさそう
records.en_original: Something tells me all we're gonna find is healthy food...
records.en_auxiliary: Something tells me all we're gonna find is healthy food...
records.en: Something tells me we'll only find healthy ingredients...

records.jp: ちょっと、どういうこと？　それ
records.en_original: Hey, what's that supposed to mean?
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, what's that supposed to mean?
records.en: Hey, what's that supposed to mean?

records.jp: 行ってらっしゃい
records.en_original: Be careful.
records.en_auxiliary: Be careful.
records.en: Have a safe trip.

records.jp: あれ？　ユズさんは行かないの？
records.en_original: Huh? You're not coming, Yuzu?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? You're not coming, Yuzu?
records.en: Huh? You're not coming, Yuzu-san?

records.jp: 私はこの世界を生み出したときに<CR>力を使い果たしてるから、戦うことはできない
records.en_original: I used all of my power in creating this world. I can't fight.
records.en_auxiliary: I used all of my power in creating this world. I can't fight.
records.en: I used up all my power when I created this world,<CR>so I cannot fight.

records.jp: それに、またクラックが発生するかもしれない。<CR>一人は学校に残っておいたほうがいいでしょ？
records.en_original: Besides, don't you think it's best someone stays at the school in case another Crack appears?
records.en_auxiliary: Besides, don't you think it's best someone stays at the school in case another Crack appears?
records.en: Besides, another Crack may appear.<CR>It would be better for one person to remain at the school, would it not?

records.jp: 何かあったら連絡するから
records.en_original: I'll send you a message if anything happens.
records.en_auxiliary: I'll send you a message if anything happens.
records.en: I'll send you a message if anything happens.

records.jp: おっけー。それじゃ――
records.en_original: Gotcha. We'll see you later!
records.en_auxiliary: Gotcha. We'll see you later!
records.en: Okay. Then—

records.jp: 準備できたら、行こう
records.en_original: Let's get ready and get moving!
records.en_auxiliary: Let's get ready and get moving!
records.en: Let's go when we're ready.
